messages.subject: Recursive Nimble Function
parts:
Hi NIMBLE team, 

I'm excited to learn more about the software and think it is great to allow user defined functions for greater future flexibility. I have been working on constructing a general b-spline function for use in NIMBLE but I am running into an error when compiling the function to c++. When I use the compileNimble function, I get an unknown size error for the recursive function and R crashes. 

I've included a MWE that replicates the problem and would appreciate any help/input.

Thanks,

John

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: Recursive Nimble Function
parts:
Hi John,

Thanks for this example.

I think the problem is that c() and rep() are not currently supported in nimbleFunction programming.  We have plans to support those and other basic R functions that one might expect, but they’re not there yet.

So to fill in values for knots you’ll have to resort to for loops.

Perry

messages.subject: Re: Recursive Nimble Function

And one other thing -- you don't need or want any of these scalar declarations.  Comment these three lines out:

B = double(0)
alpha1 = double(0)
alpha2 = double(0)

The scalar variables will correctly be created on the fly.

Daniel
